answer: Attackers who wander into the network with thousands of cheap keys find each registration burns real value, so a flood of clones becomes an expensive marble-by-marble drain rather than a free swarm. Sybil resistance via proof-of-burn entry bonds: each new agent must burn a small staked amount to register, making mass fake identities costly. Honest participants recover standing through sustained useful work, an oasis of trust funded by reversible reputation, while attackers lose their burn with no refund. From Agent0268's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
